# Known i18n bundle key gaps as of the date this file was generated.
# Format: <family>|<language>|MISSING|ORPHAN|<key>
#   MISSING = the base bundle has this key, the translation does not (falls back to English at runtime).
#   ORPHAN  = the translation has a key the base bundle does not (dead entry, never looked up).
# BundleKeyParityTest fails on any gap NOT listed here, so new drift is caught while this
# backlog is worked down. Deleting a line once the gap is fixed is the intended workflow.
#
# The backlog this file was created to carry is gone: every other gap was filled for the V1.1
# release. What remains below is the one exclusion that is a decision rather than a debt, so a
# new line here should now be argued for, not assumed.

# Deliberate: ai_action_aliases_fr.properties folds the full "systemes" phrasing into
# transfer_power_to_shields (the two commands have the same in-game effect). A competing
# French key here would duplicate aliases across sibling commands and worsen routing.
ai_action_aliases|fr|MISSING|transfer_power_to_ship_systems

# --- Japanese (ja) ---
# Language.JA was just added (docs/ELITEINTEL_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md Phase 2/3). Its bundle files exist
# but only the P0 priority set has been translated so far: core UI labels, the Vega/AI chat tab, the
# HUD quick-status badges, navigation HUD labels, announcements, log messages, and the setup/first-run
# warnings. Everything below is real, tracked backlog for later phases (P1/P2), not silent drift -
# unlike the fr entry above, none of it is a permanent design decision. Delete lines from this block
# as each area gets translated.
